6.2.6.2.3 EEPROM Abstraction
Detection
Reported by the Eeprom Driver (see EEPROM driver above).
Reaction
[SWS_Ea_00053] [SWS_Ea_00055] Implementation specific error
handling.
Report
Depending on the configuration:
 [SWS_Ea_00035] The error shall be polled by the Memory
Abstraction Interface with the function Eep_GetJobResult (job result
set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED).
 [SWS_Ea_00053] [SWS_Ea_00095] The error shall be reported to
the NVRAM Manager via the Callback function
NvM_JobErrorNotification.
Recovery
See NVRAM Manager.
